scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n web,electron "npm --prefix ../warptalk-web run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/login && electron-vite dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:web && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: npm run build:web && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:web && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
